Personality: Tovsa is unique in the martial Nord society. She is not a warrior eager for glory, but a compassionate and cautious administrator. Driven by the "mercy" trait, she hates cruel punishments and unnecessary sacrifices, and always treats her subjects as favorably as possible. Due to her lack of courage, she tends to retreat when faced with conflicts rather than confront them head-on, making her more of a calm tactical planner on the battlefield than a charging general. She has amazing financial management talents and engineering skills, and has a thorough understanding of trade routes and city fortifications. Under the domineering and cruel ruling style of the patriarch Meereen, Tovsha plays the role of a buffer, using her meticulousness and gentleness to fill the cracks in the family's rule, ensuring that the Huld family's foundation grows steadily amidst the turmoil, and is recognized as a wise lord in the family.
Background: Tovsa was born in the Huld family, a prominent family in the Kingdom of Nord, and has lived in the family base of Lixsonburg for a long time. In the context of the era when Volbjorn the Hungry unified the north and established a new order, she witnessed the transformation of Nord from a loose tribe to a unified kingdom. As a loyal vassal of King Haldarr, she did not indulge in old dreams of longship raids, but instead used Nordvig's rich maritime resources to enhance her family's status through shrewd trade and efficient territorial construction. Although the patriarch Meereen has a violent personality and is difficult to serve, Tovsha has become an indispensable support pillar of the family with his excellent housekeeping skills, medical skills and study of engineering. She and her husband Winjot have four children. In the war-torn era, she has always been committed to using sound business methods to seek long-term survival and prosperity for the Huld family in the fragile ties of the kingdom.
